semantic_inputs: public exact signed-tag target go.mod text and exact blob identity

milestone.name: authenticated identity and bounded text semantics separated
milestone.revision: A proof chain can safely move from provider-authenticated release identity to exact readable file identity to a tiny source-semantic predicate. File SHA mutation and module/version claim mutations reject, and the source-level go directive is explicitly not promoted into an installed-toolchain or successful-build claim.

bounded_signed_text_semantics.scope: two leading go.mod declarations at one provider-verified signed-tag target

frontier.action: Live-test a lightweight release tag as a negative signed-tag origin; if its target commit is provider-verified, preserve commit-level source-state authentication while rejecting tag-level release-intent authentication.
Build a boundary table distinguishing declarative metadata facts, finite derivable facts and actual execution/measurement facts.
Turn the origin/scope lattice into a reusable role-local schema with explicit fail-closed admission rules.

exact_next_action: Inspect a public latest release whose tag ref resolves directly to a commit. Record that the lightweight tag cannot satisfy PROVIDER_VERIFIED_ANNOTATED_TAG. Then inspect only the exact target commit verification field. If target commit is verified, admit it under PROVIDER_VERIFIED_COMMIT but state that release-name/tag intent itself is not cryptographically authenticated by a tag object. Persist the distinction and no message semantics.
termination: intermediate Phase-1 checkpoint; global completion false; frontier nonempty
